sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, Fig. 1 (axe components), and Discussion, Late Copper Age metallurgy in Central Italy: the cited 3350–3000 cal BCE shaft-date estimate (2 sigma)

Discussion, Provenance of the Iceman metal, Fig. 3, and Late Copper Age metallurgy in Central Italy: measured lead isotope ratios, closest southern Tuscan ore matches, production and transport uncertainties
Circumstances leading to the find and Discovery site: axe recovered with the body at Tisenjoch, 3,210 m, in 1991

summary.de: Ein Beil mit Kupferklinge und Eibenholzstiel. Bleiisotope in der Klinge passen im Vergleich am besten zu Erzen aus der südlichen Toskana.
summary.en: An axe with a copper blade and yew handle. In the lead isotope comparison, the blade is closest to ores from southern Tuscany.
